note: The real functional capabilities of apps/vscode-dsh, one entry per capability: the repo-exploration.md §12 rows plus the panel capabilities that landed with the `dsh.test.*` observability hooks (settings page, model selector, image prompt admission, session delete, compaction marker, workflow card, todo panel, reasoning capture, token meter). requiresModel marks capabilities whose verification needs a real DEEPSEEK_API_KEY round-trip (AC-9); those fail closed with SKIPPED_NO_CREDENTIALS (exit 3) when no key is present. Steps are EDH operation sequences (command / wait / stream / replay / assert / screenshot); run-vscode-dsh-e2e-closure.sh derives the per-batch id lists from requiresModel, so a new entry needs no list edit there.
